svg.title: Opening a pot at two timescales
svg.desc: Illustrative 3D rendering of a seven-axis Flexiv Rizon 4 with a Grav gripper. Four poses show the gripper approaching the pot, grasping the knob, lifting the lid, and releasing it beside the pot. The traces below illustrate gradual task progress, a brief grasp adjustment, and a smaller fluctuation at release.
svg.metadata: Robot visual meshes and kinematics: Flexiv Robotics, flexiv_description, Apache-2.0, revision 2fc4f62329fa95e0280b7a1e45c4392397b401fb. https://github.com/flexivrobotics/flexiv_description . Task objects, keyframes, lighting and camera composed for this illustration.

g.text: Lift the lid off the pot.
